source: 660 Across the Door
target: 660 Trans Ostium

source: Without hesitation, Lugano pushed himself up and hurried to the fallen horse, carefully examining it.
target: Sine mora, Lugano se excitavit et ad equum lapsum festinavit, eum diligenter inspexiens.

source: After a few seconds, he exclaimed regretfully, “It’s dead!”
target: Post paucos secundos, ille dolenter exclamavit: “Mortuus est!”

source: The poor horse was unlucky.
target: Infelix equus infortunatus fuit.

source: Despite being over a hundred meters away, it was hit twice by a flurry of gunshots.
target: Quamquam plus quam centum metris remoto, bis ictus est turbine sclopetorum.

source: One bullet struck its side, and the other hit its head.
target: Una glans in latus eius percussit, altera in caput eius percussit.

source: It couldn’t be any more dead.
target: Non potuit magis mortuus esse.

source: In contrast, the carriage driver remained unscathed.
target: In contrarium, auriga carrucae intactus mansit.

source: At most, he had scraped his skin during the tumble.
target: Maxime vero, in casu, cutem suam excoriavit.

source: Lumian glanced at Kolobo, who had his back turned to him and the others, seemingly on guard against any potential attacks from the depths of the forest.
target: Lumian Kolobum intuebatur, qui dorsum ad se et ceteros converterat, quasi in vigilia adversus impetum ex intimo silvae.

source: He led Ludwig, who had been thrown from the carriage, to the side of the motionless, bleeding horse corpse.
target: Duxit Ludovicum, qui ex carruca proiectus erat, ad latus cadaveris equi immobili et sanguinolenti.

source: “Stop the bleeding,” Lumian instructed Lugano.
target: “Sanguinem sistere,” Lumian Lugano imperavit.

source: Why stop it when the horse is already dead?
target: Cur sistere, cum equus iam mortuus sit?

source: Although Lugano didn’t understand, he extended his shimmering palm.
target: Etsi Lugano non intellexit, manum suam nitidam protulit.

source: After the dead horse’s wounds closed, Lumian turned to Ludwig and said, “Your turn.”
target: Postquam vulnera cadaveris equi clausa sunt, Lumian ad Ludovicum se vertit et dixit: “Tua vice.”

source: Ludwig, dressed in a child’s formal attire, nodded slightly.
target: Ludwig, indutus habitu formali pueri, leviter annuit.

source: He extended his right palm, gripping the dead horse with his five fingers, and slowly raised it.
target: Dextram manum protulit, quinque digitis cadaveris equi mortui tenens, et lente elevavit.

source: The blood-stained corpse of the horse suddenly stood up, causing the overturned carriage to shift slightly.
target: Cadaver equi sanguine maculatum subito surrexit, faciens carrucam conversam leviter moveri.

source: Upon seeing this, Camus gave a barely perceptible nod.
target: Videns hoc, Camus vix perceptibiliter annuit.

source: Is this child from the Death pathway or the Prisoner pathway?
target: Num hic puer de via Mortis aut de via Captivitatis?

source: However, there’s no cold aura or corpse-like aura…
target: Attamen, nec aura frigida nec aura cadaverosa est…

source: After Lugano righted the carriage, the undead horse corpse continued pulling the five of them towards Tizamo.
target: Postquam Lugano carrucam rectam redegit, cadaver equi animatum quinque eorum versus Tizamo trahere continuavit.

source: Just before noon, Lumian spotted their destination.
target: Prope meridiem, Lumian eorum destinationem animadvertit.

source: It was a small town half-encircled by rubber trees, acacia trees, laurels, and other vegetation.
target: Oppidum parvum erat, semi circumdatum arboribus caoutchouc, acaciarum, laurorum, et reliquarum vegetabilium.

source: Several plantations dotted the muddy road, and the air was filled with different spice scents and the alluring smell of roasted meat.
target: Plures plantationes viam lutosam punctabant, et aër variis aromatibus condimentorum atque odore carnis tostae delectabili impleturus erat.

source: Tizamo’s buildings were unique.
target: Aedificia Tizamo unica erant.

source: Apart from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church cathedral, which had a distinct northern style, the rest were propped up by wooden stakes and stone pillars.
target: Praeter cathedralem Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammeantis, quae stilo septentrionali distincta erat, reliqua ligneis stipulis et lapideis columnis suffulta erant.

source: They were reminiscent of West Balam—the base deliberately left empty underneath.
target: Reminiscebant West Balam, cuius basis intentionaliter vacuum relinqueretur.

source: This was due to the humid air and abundant rainfall in many West Balam areas.
target: Hoc erat propter aerem humidum et pluviam abundantem in multis regionibus West Balam.

source: Water would often overflow and pool below.
target: Aqua saepe effundebatur et in loco congregabatur.

source: Lumian climbed down from the four-wheeled, four-seater carriage, watching the people busy with their tasks in the plantation and the town.
target: Lumian de carruca quattuor rotarum et quattuor sedium descendit, spectans homines qui in plantatione atque oppido negotia agebant.

source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Trier, Regio Cathēdrālis Commemorativae, Apartmentum 702, 9 Via Orosai.

source: Franca reclined in the recliner, rocking gently as she recollected the previous day’s events.
target: Franca in solio reclinato se recubuit, leniter oscillans, dum prioris diei res recordabatur.

source: After Jenna woke up that morning, she went out to the streets to buy meat, vegetables, fruits, and bread, making Franca wonder if she had experienced a wet dream or hallucination.
target: Postquam Jenna illo mane experrecta est, in vias processit ad emendum carnem, olera, fructus, et panem, quod Francam mirari fecit num somnium umidum aut visionem passi esset.

source: Why did she suddenly volunteer to help me with digesting the potion?
target: Cur illa subito se obtulit, ut me in digestione potionis adiuvaret?

source: Compared to most Trieriens, she can definitely be considered conservative…
target: Comparata cum plurimis Trierensis, illa certe conservativa esse potest…

source: Moreover, she was so direct and straightforward that I almost lost my desires out of shock.
target: Praeterea, tam directa et sincera erat, ut paene cupiditates meas ex stupore amitterem.

source: Shouldn’t she flirt first to set the mood?
target: Nonne debet illa primum leviter flirtere, ut rem animi componat?

source: When the time comes, even if she doesn’t initiate, I won’t be able to control myself…
target: Cum tempus advenerit, etiamsi illa non initierit, ego me ipsum non regere potero…

source: The more Franca thought about it, the more puzzled she became.
target: Quo magis Franca de re cogitabat, eo magis perplexa facta est.

source: She felt Jenna wouldn’t normally act that way.
target: Sentiabat Jennam tale non solere agere.

source: After recalling Jenna’s past experiences and actions, she realized there was no issue.
target: Postquam Jennae praeteritae experientiae et actus recordata sunt, intellexit nihil esse.

source: That was precisely what Jenna would do!
target: Id prorsus erat quod Jenna faceret!

source: Jenna has a bold nature, or rather, a personality that allows her to act decisively…
target: Jenna naturam audacem habet, aut potius indolem quae ei permittit constanter agere…

source: After the Showy Diva singer who helped her was raped by Margot and became unstable, she was truly willing to go to extremes to assassinate Margot and avenge her friend.
target: Postquam cantatrix Diva ostentatrix, quae eam adiuvit, a Margot violata et instabilis facta est, vere voluit ad extrema procedere ut Margot interficeret et amicam suam ulciscaretur.

source: To that end, she even indebted herself to me for the Assassin potion and firmly became a Beyonder despite her finances…
target: Ad hoc, ipsa etiam mihi se debitorum reddidit pro potione interfectoria, et constanter Beyonder facta est, non obstante suis rebus.

source: At the Hugues Artois banquet, she faced the Member of Parliament protected by official Beyonders and evil gods’ minions.
target: Apud convivium Hugues Artois, illa opposuit membrum Parlamentarium, qui officialibus Beyonder et ministris deorum malignorum protegebatur.

source: She risked everything, disregarding her own fate.
target: Omnia periclitata est, fatum suum contemnens.

source: She killed the bastard who brought catastrophe to the market district and her family on the spot…
target: Interficit scelestum, qui calamitatem ad mercatus districtum et familiam suam in loco attulit…

source: In her heart, I should still be more important than that Showy Diva friend of hers.
target: In corde eius, ego tamen magis momenti esse videbar quam illa amica Diva ostentatrix.

source: Suddenly going to extremes and offering to help me with the potion’s effects is indeed something she would do…
target: Subito ad extrema procedere et offerre auxilium mihi in potionis effectibus, re vera est id quod illa faceret…

source: Besides, sigh, this definitely isn’t a spur-of-the-moment idea.
target: Praeterea, heu, hoc certe non est consilium ex improviso ortum.

source: She has asked me several times about my progress digesting the Pleasure potion and if I have a new partner.
target: Ea me pluries rogavit de progressu mei in digestione potionis Voluptatis et utrum novum socium haberem.

source: She even recommended Lumian…
target: Etiam Lumian commendavit…

source: Realizing that I haven’t found a new partner and that I’m only open-minded outwardly, she decided to act after being stirred by Lumian advancing to Sequence 5 yesterday…
target: Animadvertens me novum socium non invenisse et quod me tantum exteriore animo apertum esse videar, illa statuit agere postquam a Lumiano, qui ad Sequenciam 5 heri processerat, excitata est.

source: That doesn’t seem enough reason—Jenna wouldn’t sacrifice her body because of just those things.
target: Id parum videtur causae sufficere—Jenna non solum his rebus corpus suum sacrificaret.

source: Sigh, sacrifice…
target: Heu, sacrificium…

source: Could it be that she had long realized I secretly liked her and didn’t seek out a new partner because of her?
target: Num forte diu intellexerit me eam occultè amabisse atque ob eam novum socium non quaesivisse?

source: Could she believe she affected my digesting the Pleasure potion, causing her to act?
target: Num putavit se digestionem meam potionis Voluptatis affecisse, quae eam ad agendum moveret?

source: Yes! That must be it. That’s the only way she’d truly go to such extremes.
target: Ita! Id certe est; hoc modo solum vere ad extrema procederet.

source: Ahhh! Why can’t I find any hint of romantic love?
target: Ahhh! Cur nullum vestigium amoris romanticus mihi inveniatur?

source: Franca wailed inwardly.
target: Franca interius gemitu lamentabatur.

source: If she had known this would happen, she would have summoned her courage, toughened her resolve, and sought Lumian’s help.
target: Si hoc scivisset, cor suum congregasset, animum firmaverit, et auxilium Lumiani quaesivisset.

source: That way, she wouldn’t feel as conflicted and pained as she did now.
target: Ita non se sentit tam conflictuoso et dolente sicut nunc.

source: Of course, she didn’t seek out a new intimate partner partly because she cared about Jenna’s opinion.
target: Certe, illa novum intimum socium non quaesivit, partim ob curam sententiae Jennæ.

source: She had become Gardner Martin’s lover and shared his other lovers before meeting Jenna.
target: Ea facta erat amica Gardner Martin, et antequam Jennam conveniret, alios amantes eius communicaverat.

source: There was no changing that history, so she continued on.
target: Nulla vis historiam mutandi erat; itaque illa pergebat.

source: After Gardner Martin’s demise, she had claimed she wanted Browns to experience true pleasure and participate in the Demoness’s female orgies, but most of it was just talk.
target: Post Gardner Martin exitium, illa affirmavit se velle ut Browns veram voluptatem experirent atque in orgiis feminis Daemones participarent, sed pleraque id solum verba erant.

source: She was filled with anticipation only out of novelty.
target: Ea tantum ex novitate sola spe plena erat.

source: If Browns suddenly agreed, she might hesitate and make excuses.
target: Si Browns subito consenserint, illa fortasse dubitaret et excusationes afferret.

source: She didn’t want to leave an unrestrained image in Jenna or Lumian’s minds.
target: Non volebat in mentibus Jennæ aut Lumiani imaginem insuetam relinqui.

source: To put it simply, her answer to the question “Is there really no one in this world you care about?” had changed, so she was hesitant to actively pursue a new intimate partner.
target: Simpliciter, responsum eius quaestioni “Num in hoc orbe vere neminem cures?” mutatum erat, ideoque illa reticenter novum intimum socium quaereret.

source: Jenna had no substantial intimate experience, so she didn’t know how to set a mood for such situations.
target: Jenna nullam experientiam intimam habuit, ideo nesciat quomodo rem animi ad talia condenda componat.

source: She could only revert to the straightforward seduction from when she was Little Minx, but she didn’t want to deceive my feelings and make me fall deeper.
target: Illam tantum redire poterat ad seductionem simplicem, quam habebat cum Little Minx esset, sed noluit affectus meos fallere et me profundius incidere.

source: That's why she acted that way yesterday.
target: Idcirco heri ita egit.

source: Thankfully, she’s relatively level-headed.
target: Gratias Deo, illa relative mente aequa est.

source: She didn’t seek a lover to make me give up, allowing me to truly find a new intimate partner.
target: Non quaesivit amantem, ne me deredirent, ita ut vere novum intimum socium invenire possim.

source: Yes, she might think that would be giving me prolonged pain and not prolonged pleasure.
target: Ita, illa fortasse putabit id mihi dolorem diuturnum, non voluptatem diuturnam, afferre.

source: It would have hindered my digestion of the potion…
target: Hoc digestionem meam potionis impedivisset…

source: Franca felt even more dejected after piecing together the entire situation.
target: Franca, totam rem coniuncta, magis oppressa se sensit.

source: On the stairs leading to Apartment 702.
target: In scalis ad Apartmentum 702.

source: Jenna held a bag of bread and a basket of beef, vegetables, and fruits, reluctant to go back inside.
target: Jenna tenebat sacculum panis et corbem bubuli, olerum, et fructuum, recusans intrare.

source: Recalling yesterday’s events made her blush, unsure of how to face Franca.
target: Recordationes heri faciebant ut rubeficeret, nescia quomodo Francam obiretur.

source: In her previous days as a Showy Diva singer, she had witnessed others’ affection and felt it was just so-so.
target: In diebus antiquis, ut cantatrix Diva ostentatrix, aliorum amorem conspexit et id mediocriter aestimavit.

source: Although exciting, she thought she could endure it.
target: Etiamsi excitans, credidit se id tolerare posse.

source: Unexpectedly, after experiencing it for real, she realized pleasure could make people become consumed by it.
target: Inopinanter, postquam id re vera experita est, intellexit voluptatem homines penitus consumere posse.

source: Phew… Jenna took a few deep breaths to calm herself.
target: Phew… Jenna paucos spiritus profundos cepit ad se tranquilluandum.

source: What troubled her now was how to interact with Franca.
target: Quod eam nunc perturbabat, erat quomodo cum Franca ageret.

source: Wait, should I pretend nothing happened and face her with my usual demeanor?
target: Exspecta, num simularer nihil accidisse et eam consueto animo obire debeam?

source: Should I be more cheerful and take the initiative to mention yesterday, pretending it’s no big deal so Franca doesn’t mind?
target: Num debeam magis laetus esse et initium capere ut heri rem meminisse, simulans nihil esse magni, ne Franca curam habeat?

source: But won’t this upset her?
target: Sed num hoc eam non perturbabit?

source: She needs to digest the Pleasure potion…
target: Ea opus habet ut potionem Voluptatis digerat…

source: Besides, one pleasure encounter is definitely not enough.
target: Praeterea, una congressio voluptatis certe non sufficit.

source: I have to spend time with her as a couple…
target: Tempus cum ea consumere debeo sicut coniuges…

source: Should I keep seducing her tonight like yesterday, or wait for her to initiate?
target: Num debeam seducere eam hac nocte sicut heri, aut exspectare ut illa initet?

source: Dammit, how annoying!
target: Heu, quam molestum!

source: Jenna found such matters more vexing than assassinating powerful figures.
target: Jenna talia re magis vexantia inveniebat quam figuras potentissimas interficere.

source: Whether avenging herself on Margot or killing Hugues Artois, she had always felt death was the worst outcome—no big deal.
target: Sive se ulciscere a Margot sive Hugues Artois interficere, illa semper sensit mortem esse exitum pessimum—nihil magni.

source: However, this situation clearly hadn't reached life-or-death stakes.
target: Attamen, haec condicio clare non pervenit ad gradus vitae et mortis.

source: The subsequent troubles would linger.
target: Incommoda subsequentia manere destinabantur.

source: Jenna couldn’t help but feel frustrated at the thought of maintaining an intimate physical relationship with Franca and all the complexities involved.
target: Jenna non potuit quin frustrata se sentire, cum cogitaret de retinenda relatione intima cum Franca et omnibus complexitatibus.

source: She wished she could simply assassinate the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, instead.
target: Vellet ut potius Ministrum Industriae, Moran Avigny, interficeret.

source: Taking deep breaths to steady her emotions, Jenna analyzed how to approach this from an actress’s perspective to make Franca more accepting of future intimacies.
target: Profundos spiritus hauriens ad animi tranquillitatem, Jenna perscrutavit quomodo ex prospectu actricis hanc rem accedendum facere posset, ut Franca futuras intimas relationes magis acciperet.

source: She had already taken the first bold step.
target: Iam primum audacem gradum fecerat.

source: She definitely wasn’t willing to give up now.
target: Certe nunc non voluit cedere.

source: She planned to continue their relationship until Franca finished digesting the Pleasure potion’s effects.
target: Consilium habebat ut relationem pergeret, donec Franca digestionem effectuum potionis Voluptatis perfecerit.

source: After figuring out her next move, Jenna’s lips curled into a faint smile.
target: Postquam proximam consiliam excogitavit, labia Jennæ leniter in risum incurvarunt.

source: Carrying bread and ingredients, she briskly climbed the stairs and returned to Apartment 702.
target: Panem et ingredientes portans, illa festinanter scalas ascendit et ad Apartmentum 702 rediit.

source: As soon as she opened the door, Franca jumped up from the recliner instinctively and forced a smile.
target: Cum ostium aperuisset, Franca ex solio reclinato instinctu surrexit et risum effecit.

source: She said nervously, “You’re back?”
target: Nervose dixit: “Rediisti?”

source: Amused by Franca’s actions, Jenna chuckled and sighed inwardly.
target: Ob facta Francae delectata, Jenna subridens et internis suspiravit.

source: How great would it be if you didn’t want to become lovers…
target: Quam pulchrum esset, si nolis amatores fieri…

source: Jenna calmly walked to the dining table and placed her items on it.
target: Jenna tranquille ad mensam cenariam processit et res suas in eam posuit.

source: Then, she glared at Franca.
target: Tum, oculis iracundis, Francam aspexit.

source: “What are you waiting for? Help me!”
target: “Quid expectas? Adiuva me!”

source: “Alright, alright.” Franca hurried over.
target: “Bene, bene.” Franca festinanter advenit.

source: Seeing that Jenna wasn’t reserved or distant, nor reverted to her usual demeanor, she felt an inexplicable relief.
target: Videns Jenna non esse remota nec reticens, nec consuetam indolem retinuisse, illa inexplicabilem levationem sensit.

source: She even began to anticipate the night’s arrival.
target: Etiam coepit adventum noctis exspectare.

source: Sizzle. Sizzle.
target: Fritit. Fritit.

source: The juices from a piece of beef dripped onto the fire, transforming into smoke that swirled upwards, blending with the aroma of spices.
target: Sucus ex segmento bubuli in ignem stillavit, transformatus in fumum qui sursum volitabat, et cum odore specierum se miscuit.

source: This caused Ludwig to swallow a few mouthfuls of saliva.
target: Hoc effecit ut Ludwig paucos sorbos salivae deglutiret.

source: However, the boy patiently waited, not rushing the cook until the beef roasted to its optimal state.
target: Attamen puer patienter exspectabat, coquinum non festinans, donec bubulus ad optimum statum assatus esset.

source: Lumian turned his body and gazed at a three‐story building diagonally across from the restaurant.
target: Lumian se convertit et aedificium trium tabulorum, diagonaliter trans cauponam, intuebatur.

source: The yellowish‐brown house was the former residence rebuilt by Hisoka Twanaku.
target: Domus flavido-brunneus erat, quae a Hisoka Twanaku refecta erat.
